Actually, let me reconsider: strain gauge load cells are definitively analog in R60 terminology. Many extractors would mark it analog. I'll include "Analog load cell" — risk of fabrication. Hmm. The instruction 8 says if a field is not present, omit it. The concept "analog" is not present. I'll omit (null).

The range is a single characteristic value {min: 10, max: 50} unit t. I think model_family should be omitted since there's no explicit model variants list; type designation is TS with Emax range. I'll put maximum_capacity as type_level characteristic with value {min: 10, max: 50}, unit_symbol "t".

Tolerance: I could add a separate characteristic input_impedance_tolerance: 15 Ω. Hmm. Simplest: input_impedance: value 700, unit "Ω"; input_impedance_tolerance: value 15, unit "Ω". I'll use value + tolerance as separate characteristic. Actually maybe cleaner: keep "input_impedance" with value 700 and add "input_impedance_tolerance". I'll do that.
